services.title: Websites & Custom Software
services.shortDescription: Build your business website, online store, customer portal, or custom application, with an agreed plan for ongoing care.
services.fullDescription: We build professional websites, online stores, customer portals, and custom software around your business needs. Work includes the agreed design, implementation, testing, launch preparation, and handover. Ongoing care can cover maintenance, content updates, monitoring, and minor improvements within a defined monthly allocation.
services.targetAudience: Small business owners needing a dependable digital presence, and founders building a custom software product.
problemsSolved: An outdated or missing business website
A product idea that needs implementation
No clear owner for ongoing website maintenance
deliverables: Agreed website or application design and implementation
Content management, forms, and integrations as scoped
Testing, launch preparation, and handover documentation
Optional website care with covered tasks and capacity defined
engagementProcess: Agree pages, functionality, responsibilities, and milestones
Hand over or begin an agreed care plan

services.title: Product & Technology Management
services.shortDescription: Turn your idea into a practical roadmap, coordinate development, and keep improving your product after launch.
services.fullDescription: We help define requirements, prioritize work, coordinate engineering, and manage product delivery. Start with discovery and a roadmap, or engage ongoing fractional technical product management. Monthly agreements define the allocation, meeting cadence, decision responsibilities, and review process.
services.targetAudience: Founders, startups, and teams that need product direction or fractional technical product leadership.
deliverables: Product discovery, requirements, and prioritized roadmap
Backlog and acceptance criteria
Engineering coordination and stakeholder updates
Product reviews within an agreed monthly allocation

services.title: Customer Support Systems
services.shortDescription: Set up ticketing, knowledge bases, chatbots, and customer communication workflows so inquiries are easier to manage.
services.fullDescription: We set up and improve the technology behind customer support: shared inquiries, ticketing, knowledge bases, chatbots, routing, and reporting. Ongoing support-system management can cover configuration, workflow monitoring, and optimization. The service does not include human support-agent staffing, answering every customer conversation, or 24-hour coverage.
services.targetAudience: Businesses organizing customer inquiries or improving an existing support platform.
deliverables: Support platform and routing configuration
Knowledge-base setup and agreed chatbot workflows
Escalation rules, reporting, and team handover
Optional ongoing platform management with agreed service hours
engagementProcess: Agree tools, responsibilities, and escalation rules
Document and hand over to your team
Review and improve within the agreed scope

services.title: Business Automation
services.shortDescription: Simplify follow-ups, appointment reminders, data entry, document processing, and reporting with connected workflows.
services.fullDescription: We review repetitive business tasks and implement suitable automations and integrations. Work can include customer follow-ups, reminders, document processing, reporting, and appropriate AI assistance. Ongoing management can cover monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization of the agreed workflows; software subscriptions and new workflows are scoped separately.
services.targetAudience: Business owners and teams spending too much time on repetitive administrative or operational tasks.
deliverables: Workflow review and prioritized automation scope
Agreed workflow implementation and integrations
Testing, exception handling, and operating documentation
Optional monitoring and maintenance with defined usage limits

services.title: Software Architecture & Technical Advisory
services.shortDescription: Make informed decisions about system design, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, and modernization.
services.fullDescription: Make informed decisions about system design, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, and modernization. Advisory engagements provide designs and recommendations; implementation and ongoing operational support are separate, explicitly scoped options.
services.targetAudience: Founders, CTOs, and engineering teams designing a platform or reviewing an existing system.
deliverables: Architecture assessment and diagrams
Technical trade-off and risk register
API, data, and cloud recommendations
Prioritized implementation roadmap

engagements.name: Product Discovery Sprint
engagements.description: For founders and teams with an idea, unclear requirements, or competing priorities. Resolve scope uncertainty before committing to a build. A fixed-scope engagement combines discovery sessions, written requirements, and a roadmap review; scope and schedule are agreed after discovery.

engagements.name: Custom Engineering Engagement
engagements.description: For businesses that need a custom application, MVP, or integration implemented. Turn an agreed product scope into working software through reviewed delivery milestones. Scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, deployment responsibilities, and support are agreed in the proposal.

engagements.name: Fractional Technical Product Management
engagements.description: For growing teams that need technical product leadership without a full-time hire. Address backlog uncertainty, delivery coordination, and stakeholder alignment through a retainer with an agreed allocation, meeting cadence, responsibilities, and review cycle.

caseStudy.title: ClinchDesk
caseStudy.summary: A multi-tenant customer support SaaS platform combining ticket management, role-based access, customer portals, SLA workflows, knowledge management, and AI-assisted support.
caseStudy.businessProblem: Customer support needs coordinated ticket handling, customer access, service-level workflows, and reusable knowledge within each organization. ClinchDesk brings these workflows together in a multi-tenant product.
caseStudy.role: Product and engineering work on ClinchDesk; a detailed account of responsibilities is pending verification against the project repository.
caseStudy.requirements: Bring ticket management, role-based access control, customer portals, SLA workflows, knowledge management, and AI-assisted support into one multi-tenant support platform.
caseStudy.architecture: Multi-tenant SaaS with role-based access control and customer-facing portals. Infrastructure choices, tenant isolation mechanisms, and AI provider details require confirmation from the project repository.
caseStudy.implementation: The product brings support ticket workflows, customer portals, service-level processes, and knowledge management together, with AI-assisted support as one capability. A code-level implementation walkthrough is pending verification against the ClinchDesk repository.
caseStudy.challenges: Tenant boundaries and role permissions need review across support workflows. AI assistance requires evaluation and human oversight. Specific implementation challenges and resolutions have not yet been verified.
caseStudy.outcomes: The documented feature scope is a multi-tenant customer support platform. Customer adoption, revenue, performance measurements, deployment status, and project lessons are not asserted here; they require supporting evidence.
